description: This file contains functions for parsing and transforming locators and selectors used in Playwright testing framework, including handling of locator strings, conversion to selector engines, and digest comparison for locator validation.

methods.name: parseLocator
methods.description: Parses a locator string into a selector and preferred quote, handling various locator syntaxes and escaping.

methods.name: countParams
methods.description: Counts the number of parameter placeholders in a template string.

methods.name: shiftParams
methods.description: Adjusts parameter placeholders in a template string by a given offset.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a locator template into a selector string, handling filters, nested locators, and parameter substitution.

methods.name: locatorOrSelectorAsSelector
methods.description: Converts a locator string to a selector string, with error handling.

methods.name: unsafeLocatorOrSelectorAsSelector
methods.description: Attempts to parse a locator as a selector; if invalid, transforms it into a selector string.

methods.name: digestForComparison
methods.description: Creates a normalized digest of a locator string for comparison purposes, considering language-specific escaping.
